method: Fine-tuned Laya scorer plus trained structured-state residual neural adapter. Encoder/transformer frozen.
selection: Adapter epoch maximizes 0.7 validation combat macro F1 + 0.3 overall validation macro F1. Class-balanced confidence-weighted loss. Validation only temperature. Previous failed/imbalanced runs retained. Same temporal test used for diagnostic iterations; no independent-match test.

manifest.label_warning: CV cooldown and joystick labels are noisy; visual review is assistant review. This is one edited match, not independent matches.

limitations: One edited match; no win-rate or live-game validation.
Automated cooldown labels can be wrong.
Movement labels are weak. Attack and retreat labels are sparse.
Reposition class learns when to rotate, not a navigation route.
CV is not a trained object detector and cannot reliably identify Nolan or marks.
